name: sends-race-instead-of-chaining
code: sendLifecycleConfig: fire each send on its own instead of chaining onto sendChain, so signing time decides arrival order

name: context-resolved-at-send-call
code: postConnectionSetup: contextSent.resolve() right after calling sendLifecycleConfig, not from its completion

edits.find:
/\ UNCHANGED << lsCfg, lsFresh, glob, fetch, fetchOks, ctxSent, lctx, destroyed, detached,
                    repushes, reloads, ghosts >>
edits.replace:
/\ UNCHANGED << lsCfg, lsFresh, glob, fetch, fetchOks, lctx, destroyed, detached,
                    repushes, reloads, ghosts >>

name: setup-skips-fetch-without-cache
code: postConnectionSetup: return without awaiting configPromise even when no cached config was sent, so nothing resolves contextSent before setup ends

name: naive-fra-444-fix
code: postConnectionSetup: when configPromise yields undefined, skip mergeAndSetConfig and the send entirely

edits.find:
/\ LET cfg == IF fetch = "ok" THEN Backend(fetchOks) ELSE Fallback
       IN /\ glob' = cfg
edits.replace:
/\ LET cfg == IF fetch = "ok" THEN Backend(fetchOks) ELSE Fallback
       IN IF fetch = "fail" THEN UNCHANGED << glob, lsCfg, lsFresh, chain >> ELSE
          /\ glob' = cfg

name: fra-444-candidate-fix
code: FRA-444's candidate: on undefined, skip merge and send only when the cached config was already sent; otherwise keep today's fallback

edits.find:
/\ LET cfg == IF fetch = "ok" THEN Backend(fetchOks) ELSE Fallback
       IN /\ glob' = cfg
edits.replace:
/\ LET cfg == IF fetch = "ok" THEN Backend(fetchOks) ELSE Fallback
       IN IF fetch = "fail" /\ sentCached THEN UNCHANGED << glob, lsCfg, lsFresh, chain >> ELSE
          /\ glob' = cfg

name: fra-444-full-fix
code: As fra-444-candidate-fix, and the fallback is published but never written to the localStorage cache

edits.find:
/\ LET cfg == IF fetch = "ok" THEN Backend(fetchOks) ELSE Fallback
       IN /\ glob' = cfg
          /\ lsCfg' = cfg
          /\ lsFresh' = TRUE
edits.replace:
/\ LET cfg == IF fetch = "ok" THEN Backend(fetchOks) ELSE Fallback
       IN IF fetch = "fail" /\ sentCached THEN UNCHANGED << glob, lsCfg, lsFresh, chain >> ELSE
          /\ glob' = cfg
          /\ IF fetch = "ok" THEN lsCfg' = cfg /\ lsFresh' = TRUE ELSE UNCHANGED << lsCfg, lsFresh >>

name: setup-stops-when-destroyed
code: postConnectionSetup: return before mergeAndSetConfig when destroy() already ran
